host.name: zbook
host.gpu: AMD RYZEN AI MAX+ PRO 395 w/ Radeon 8060S
host.load: idle (cached-arm pooled RTF 1.204/1.222 against the retained 1.201)

change: the diffusion head caches its invariant work: timestep MLP keyed by the bf16-rounded timestep, condition projection skipped on unchanged condition bytes, silu(c) hoisted above the layer loop

protocol.workload: pinned single-speaker session request, 121-token prompt, 27 generated tokens, 25 diffusion frames at 20 solver steps, CFG 1.3, 3.333 s of audio at 24 kHz
protocol.ab: one process, one machine state, arm order cached/uncached/cached/uncached, 3 repeats per arm

arms.uncached: VibevoiceTTSDiffusionHeadGPU.forward_into wrapped to clear _t_mlp_cache and _cond_proj_key before every call, forcing both weight-read caches to miss

protocol.arm_scope_note: the uncached arm disables the two weight-read caches only; the silu(c) hoist is active in both arms, so the measured delta is a lower bound on the full change

cache_neutrality.method: cached vs uncached arms over all 25 recorded calls, every one of the 20 solver steps, comparing per-step eps and speech

frozen_fixture_parity.method: call0 GPU vs the CPU reference, the metric the frozen test asserts
frozen_fixture_parity.note: every margin reproduces the value recorded in the frozen test's baseline comment

task_quality.method: 10-seed generated-audio suite at HEAD (caching plus device solver), microsoft/VibeVoice-ASR-HF transcript WER against the script text
task_quality.note: per-request pass counts, per-seed failures and stability flags identical to the recorded 2026-09-15 suite

run_basis.injected: nothing (own VAE draw, own diffusion noise, own negative LM)
run_basis.note: both runs are the unassisted path, not the fixture-assisted session bench; this is the evidence that the quality gate covers the unassisted request path

task_quality.exit_code_note: the suite exits 1 whenever any request-run fails, so its 58/60 runs report exit 1. That is the failure signal, not a crash: both runs completed synthesis and scoring for all 60 request-runs and wrote their artifact.

prior_claim_correction.carried_estimate: 1.0939x on the diffusion frame, ~99 ms per request
prior_claim_correction.measured: 1.1386x on the diffusion frame, ~150 ms per request
prior_claim_correction.interpretation: the carried figure was measured before the device solver landed; the current same-session A/B supersedes it and is larger
